title: Plücker degrees of Quot schemes
summary: We study the Plücker degree of the main component of the Quot scheme of length $l$ quotients of a locally free sheaf on a smooth projective scheme $\mathrm{S}$ of dimension $d\geqslant 1$. This degree is determined by classes in the Chow ring of the symmetric product $\mathrm{S}^{(l)}$, which are given by the pushforward of the powers of $c_{1}(\mathcal{O}^{[l]})$ with respect to the canonical morphism from the Quot scheme to $\mathrm{S}^{(l)}$.
